description: Committee advises on retroactive deck addition at 850 University Drive.
Heritage property added deck without prior approval.

chips.text: Councillor Louise found the new deck's modern aesthetic incompatible with the heritage house.
Owners Rebecca and Josh Clarino applied for retroactive heritage approval.
Neighbors and local residents provided positive feedback on the new deck.
Committee will provide detailed feedback to administration via a letter.

description: Event on November 14 at Louie's Loft.
Panel discusses the future of heritage.

chips.text: Heritage Society members encouraged to attend 15th anniversary celebration.
Update on the Conservatory, as originally requested, was not provided.
